what: OA-17 (MED, ops). System-action requests are silently DROPPED when several are queued. MEASURED 2026-10-04: runs 37190355256 (#16251, breakout_1 executor-disable-timer) and 37191556184 (#16263, tradeify_1 executor-enable-timer) ended 'cancelled' while pending, never executed; each issue stayed open with ZERO comments, so the requester sees nothing. Cause: .github/workflows/system-actions.yml:274-276 has one shared concurrency group 'system-actions' with cancel-in-progress: false. GitHub still keeps only ONE pending run per group, so a newer request cancels the older pending one. With several lanes filing (e.g. the 09:22Z tradeify round-trip-dry), an OA-03 de-risk step (timer disable) was lost without trace. Proposed fix (Tier-1 CI, manager review): either (a) a sweeper that, on a system-actions run concluding 'cancelled', comments on and re-labels its issue so it is re-dispatched (or at least says 'cancelled — re-file'); or (b) per-action concurrency groups for read-only actions. Note: GitHub's single-pending limit means queueing alone cannot fix it; the drop must be made visible and retried.
